hooks.command: if [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.markitect" ]; then MARKITECT_ENSURE_ONLY=1 sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect"; fi; true
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *[Mm][Aa][Rr][Kk][Ii][Tt][Ee][Cc][Tt]*[[:space:]][Mm][Aa][Rr][Kk]*) printf '%s' "$input" | sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect" hook pretool || exit 1 ;; esac

input=$(cat); [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.markitect" ] || exit 0; case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*) case "$input" in *.[Mm][Aa][Rr][Kk][Ii][Tt][Ee][Cc][Tt]*|*markitect-reviewer*|*markitect-architect*|*markitect-auditor*|*[Ss][Ee][Tt][Tt][Ii][Nn][Gg][Ss]*.[Jj][Ss][Oo][Nn]*|*[Aa][Gg][Ee][Nn][Tt][Ss].[Mm][Dd]*|*[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee].[Mm][Dd]*|*[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee].[Ll][Oo][Cc][Aa][Ll].[Mm][Dd]*|*.[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee]?[Hh][Oo][Oo][Kk][Ss]?*|*.[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee]??[Hh][Oo][Oo][Kk][Ss]?*|*.[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee]?[Rr][Uu][Ll][Ee][Ss]?*|*.[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee]??[Rr][Uu][Ll][Ee][Ss]?*|*/[Mm][Aa][Rr][Kk][Ii][Tt][Ee][Cc][Tt]-*|*'\\'[Mm][Aa][Rr][Kk][Ii][Tt][Ee][Cc][Tt]-*) printf '%s' "$input" | sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect" hook pretool || exit 1 ;; esac ;; esac

input=$(cat); [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.markitect" ] || exit 0; case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*) case "$input" in *[Mm][Aa][Rr][Kk][Ii][Tt][Ee][Cc][Tt]*|*Workflow*) printf '%s' "$input" | sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect" hook pretool || exit 1 ;; esac ;; esac
